records.name: active-goal
records.purpose: Live outcome of this effort
records.canonical_for: the live goal of this subject

records.name: current-position
records.purpose: Live position: current phase and what is in flight
records.canonical_for: the live position of this subject

records.name: phase
records.purpose: The plan for one phase of the project: problem, approach, and exit criteria
records.canonical_for: the plan for this phase

records.name: work-item
records.purpose: A unit of work with a staged lifecycle and dependencies on other work
records.canonical_for: the work item for this subject

records.name: acceptance
records.purpose: What done means for this change
records.canonical_for: what done means for this change

records.name: constraint
records.purpose: A confirmed constraint that is not a choice and has no alternatives
records.canonical_for: the confirmed constraint for this subject

records.name: check-run
records.purpose: That this criterion was tested at a revision
records.canonical_for: that this criterion was tested at this revision

records.name: decision
records.purpose: An adopted choice among alternatives
records.canonical_for: the adopted choice for this question

records.name: continuity-question
records.purpose: A blocker that stops dispatch or resume
records.canonical_for: whether this unknown blocks continuity

records.name: failed-attempt
records.purpose: An approach that should not be retried as-is
records.canonical_for: that this approach was abandoned

records.name: investigation-observation
records.purpose: What was observed while diagnosing or evaluating
records.canonical_for: what was observed in this investigation

records.name: finding
records.purpose: Root cause or comparative evaluation conclusion
records.canonical_for: the investigation conclusion for this claim

records.name: assignment
records.purpose: What the orchestrator handed an executor for a work-item
records.canonical_for: the dispatch of this work-item to this executor

records.name: assignment-amendment
records.purpose: A mid-flight correction to an assignment already in progress
records.canonical_for: the correction issued to this assignment

records.name: execution-report
records.purpose: What an executor returned for its assignment, body verbatim
records.canonical_for: what this executor returned for this assignment

records.name: specification
records.purpose: What must be true for this phase
records.canonical_for: what must be true for this phase

records.name: design
records.purpose: How the specification should work
records.canonical_for: how the specification should work

records.name: integration-report
records.purpose: Semantic integration of parallel work, distinct from a git merge
records.canonical_for: the semantic integration of parallel work for this phase

records.name: assessment
records.purpose: Given the check-runs, what the requirement's evidence means and which stage is next. A check-run does not carry this.
records.canonical_for: what this requirement's evidence means and which stage is next

records.name: release
records.purpose: Ready means every requirement is verified. It is not deployment. The other states exist for a later phase.
records.canonical_for: whether this effort's requirements are ready

records.name: feedback
records.purpose: An external signal engage can route into specify. Nothing collects it.
records.canonical_for: the external signal engage can route into specify

records.name: backlog-item
records.purpose: Deferred work parked on an effort until promoted or dismissed
records.canonical_for: the deferred backlog item for this subject
